example.title: Old silo along the Spanish Fork River Trail

brief: Whitewashed poured-concrete silo about 16 ft across and 42 ft high, the lime wash flaking in grey patches and faint horizontal form lines showing, open-topped with a thin rough rim; a plain flat concrete chute enclosure runs up one side, ending short of the ground on concrete legs. It stands at the edge of a pasture behind a wire fence, with a weathered plank shed and willows behind. (Poured concrete; nearest vocabulary type is concrete_stave.)
